definitions.unique_sequences: Number of distinct non-empty normalized sequences.
definitions.exact_duplicates: Number of additional rows sharing an identical non-empty normalized sequence.
definitions.noncanonical_sequences: Number of non-empty sequences containing at least one character outside the configured alphabet.
definitions.label_conflicts: Number of duplicated normalized sequences associated with more than one label profile.
definitions.length_statistics: Calculated using valid, non-empty sequences only.
